title: Normal-Order Reduction Strategy
description: Implement normal_order_step and reduce_normal to contract the leftmost, outermost beta-redex at each step.

steps.description: In normal_order_step(term), check is_redex(term) before descending into subterms so an outermost redex is contracted immediately.
For an App node that is not itself a redex, recurse into term.func first (leftmost) and only try term.arg if term.func did not step.

steps.question: If both term.func and term.arg contain redexes inside an App, which one does normal_order_step contract?
steps.answer: It contracts the redex inside term.func and returns immediately on line 15, leaving term.arg untouched on this step.

steps.description: For a Lam node, recurse into term.body to reduce under lambda abstractions, or return (term, False) when no redex remains.
Define reduce_normal(term, max_steps, trace) to call normal_order_step in a loop until stepped is False or max_steps is reached.
